title: transpose returns tuples and silently truncates ragged rows
body: `transpose(rows)` in `grid/matrix.py` is built on `zip(*rows)`. It returns a list of tuples although callers expect a list of lists, and when rows have different lengths it silently drops values. It should return a new list of lists (the input must not be modified), raise `ValueError` if the rows do not all have the same length, and return `[]` for no rows.
